_note: Every format is asked every day, of all three models, and the site displays one by default with a visitor-facing switcher for the rest. The default is seeded from the date: it varies day to day but a rebuild within a day cannot re-roll it. Comparability holds within each format panel, since all three models share the format there. The switcher CSS is generated from this file at build time, so adding or removing a format needs no other change.

formats.label: A memo to a CMO
formats.instruction: Write it as a short internal memo to a chief marketing officer. Plain language, no jargon they would have to look up. Around 120 words.

formats.label: Three moves
formats.instruction: Give exactly three moves, in order. One sentence each, then one sentence on what makes that move hard. Nothing else.

formats.label: Pseudocode
formats.instruction: Express the approach as short annotated pseudocode. The comments should carry the reasoning; the code should carry the structure. Around 15 lines.

formats.label: A checklist
formats.instruction: Give a checklist someone could actually run next quarter. Each item concrete enough to be marked done or not done. Six items at most.

formats.label: Fifty words
formats.instruction: Fifty words or fewer. No preamble, no caveats. The compression is the point: keep only what you would keep if you could keep one thing.

formats.label: A haiku
formats.instruction: Three lines, 5-7-5 syllables. A severe constraint on a serious problem: what survives the compression is what you actually think matters most.
